## About
Phuong Hoang Co., Ltd (Công ty TNHH KHKT Phượng Hoàng) is a Vietnamese electrical safety equipment manufacturer founded in 2018, headquartered in Bắc Ninh. We specialize in leakage protection, surge protection, overvoltage protection, and arc fault detection for industrial, commercial, and residential applications.
